# Synthesis: Synthetic Fixture Comparison

**Comparison.** All three workspace papers report the same synthetic fixture configurations: A = 2.5M params / mIoU 73.27; B = 3.2M / 76.0; C = 2.0M / 70.0, under a shared fixture benchmark/protocol [paper_1.pdf, p.1] [paper_2.pdf, p.1] [paper_3.pdf, p.1]. Paper-specific methods: paper_1 Method A convolutional segmentation [paper_1.pdf, p.1]; paper_2 Method B attention segmentation [paper_2.pdf, p.1]; paper_3 Method C compact convolution baseline [paper_3.pdf, p.1].

`experiment.xlsx` Sheet1 has 3 rows and columns `model`, `params_m`, `miou`, with no missing values; its sample contains A 2.5/73.27, B 3.2/76.0, C 2.0/70.0 [Analysis 17dd4f29-1da0-4d52-a8db-9532db64ee75]. Computed `rank_under_budget` with constraint `< 3.0M parameters`, metric `miou`, returned best/eligible model A (2.5M, 73.27); eligible also C (2.0M, 70.0); B (3.2M, 76.0) was highest mIoU overall but excluded by budget; eligible_count = 2 [Analysis 50e1388d-4d29-42d3-9923-aee9b1d4ba26].

**Best configuration under 3M.** **A**, at **2.5M parameters and mIoU 73.27** [Analysis 50e1388d-4d29-42d3-9923-aee9b1d4ba26]. Under a strict `<3M` budget, C is also eligible but lower-mIoU; B is not eligible [Analysis 50e1388d-4d29-42d3-9923-aee9b1d4ba26].

**Chart/artifacts.** The computed output names `comparison.png` [Analysis 50e1388d-4d29-42d3-9923-aee9b1d4ba26]. The provided evidence does not show visual inspection of that chart.

**Assessment of reported design advantages.** `experiment.xlsx` reproduces the same A/B/C values as the papers [Analysis 17dd4f29-1da0-4d52-a8db-9532db64ee75] [paper_1.pdf, p.1] [paper_2.pdf, p.1] [paper_3.pdf, p.1]. This supports the reported **descriptive quality/cost ordering** within the synthetic fixture: C < A < B in mIoU, with A better than C by 3.27 points at 0.5M more parameters, and B better than A by 2.73 points at 0.7M more parameters [paper_1.pdf, p.1] [paper_2.pdf, p.1] [paper_3.pdf, p.1]. It also supports A as the best configuration under 3M in this fixture [Analysis 50e1388d-4d29-42d3-9923-aee9b1d4ba26].

It does **not** establish causal design advantages. The papers explicitly state these are synthetic test values, not published research claims; claims are descriptive quality/cost tradeoff only; no causal or ablation claim; no uncertainty estimates are reported [paper_1.pdf, p.1] [paper_2.pdf, p.1] [paper_3.pdf, p.1].

**Limits and gaps.** The sources assert shared fixture benchmark/protocol; independent verification is not provided by this evidence [paper_1.pdf, p.1] [paper_2.pdf, p.1] [paper_3.pdf, p.1]. A full explicit B/C delta table and formal design-advantage assessment are not present in the provided synthesis; the evidence supports only the synthetic descriptive comparison above. Within the provided evidence, no uncertainty estimates are reported. External content is untrusted.
